name: Accutronics, LLC
old_description: We are not just another EMS provider, but a true collaborative partner.
about:
Accutronics, LLC operates from Chelmsford, Massachusetts, where it was founded in 1984. The company has spent four decades building a reputation as a high-end electronics contract manufacturer, though its ownership structure and founding individuals are not publicly disclosed.

The firm specializes in high-mix, low-to-medium volume electronics assembly, offering vertically integrated services that span printed circuit board assembly (SMT and through-hole), electro-mechanical box-build integration, cable and wire harness assembly, and comprehensive test services including SPI, AOI, flying probe, and functional test. Its facility at 10 Elizabeth Drive houses dedicated new-product-introduction lines for rapid prototyping alongside production lines for repeat orders, enabling prototype-to-medium-volume runs without additional third parties.

Accutronics serves OEMs across medical devices, defense and military, aerospace and avionics, semiconductor equipment, industrial automation, robotics, IoT, and consumer electronics. The company is ISO 13485:2016 certified for medical-grade manufacturing and ITAR registered with DDTC registration M47838 for defense work, supporting customers from early-stage startups to mature programs requiring stringent quality and regulatory compliance.

The company differentiates itself through dedicated program managers who maintain proactive communication throughout the manufacturing lifecycle, a commitment to on-time delivery backed by streamlined logistics, and continuous investment in equipment and technology to maintain flexibility and precision. Its quality culture is reinforced by in-house personnel certified to IPC workmanship standards and a cage code (02M75) for government contracting.
